title: HG’s South Africa storyline
headers: SITUATION | The market and its drivers
columns:
Outline South African demand development and Vopak’s market of interest: eastern South Africa within economic reach of its storage infrastructure and NMPP.

Explain the demand drivers: greater diesel use in power generation; rail to road; fuel prices; more efficient vehicles; and slow GDP growth.

Outline the supply picture: refinery closures, challenges at Secunda and closure of Mossgas. Show growth in imports and where they enter.

A number of trends that supported demand growth have started to reverse: road to rail; the end of loadshedding and spare generation capacity; EVs/HEVs; and higher fuel prices affecting kilometres travelled.

Explore supply changes: a SAPREF restart; Secunda’s coal-derived gas, MRG sales and potential extension to 2032; and Natref’s future.

Compare Durban storage–NMPP–Lesedi with road/rail from Durban, transport from Matola and transport from Walvis Bay.

Market share of Vopak in Durban and Lesedi

Potential scope for new investment?
